key_insight: CADAQUES makes cost a first-class part of autonomous discovery by explicitly budgeting both queries and decision-making within a dual Oracle-Driver loop.
engineering_relevance: This framework helps scientific ML and simulation campaigns avoid hidden compute, time, and token costs while enabling more efficient, auditable query planning.
method: Separates the loop into an Oracle that answers queries and a Driver that proposes them
Tracks a shared vector-valued budget for wall time, CPU hours, money, and LLM tokens
Records an append-only ledger of declared vs. settled costs for each transaction
evidence_signal: On the 2D Ising critical-temperature task, low-fidelity exploration followed by higher-fidelity refinement produced lower and less variable errors than always using high fidelity at the studied budget scale.
watch_item: The reported benefits come from one noisy benchmark and a specific budget regime, so results may not generalize to all discovery problems or cost structures.
paper_title: CADAQUES: A Cost-Aware Dual Architecture for Query-Efficient Autonomous Discovery
